tools.name: easybroker_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties in the account with filters for status, type, operation, price, bedrooms and bathrooms. Read-only. Use easybroker_get_property for full details. GET /properties.

tools.name: easybroker_get_property
tools.description: Return the full details of one property by its id, for example EB-B0579. Read-only. GET /properties/{property_id}.

tools.name: easybroker_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (leads and clients) in the account, filtered by status, probability, tag, email, office, source or dates. Read-only. GET /contacts.

tools.name: easybroker_get_contact
tools.description: Return the full details of one contact by its id. Read-only. GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: easybroker_update_contact
tools.description: Update only the fields you send on an existing contact (name, status, probability, tags, notes and more). Changes the live contact record. PATCH /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: easybroker_list_contact_requests
tools.description: List the contact requests (enquiries about properties) received in a period or for one property. Read-only. GET /contact_requests.

tools.name: easybroker_create_contact_request
tools.description: Create a new contact request (a lead about a property) in the account. Each call creates a new record and can notify the agent. POST /contact_requests.

tools.name: easybroker_list_property_types
tools.description: List the property types available in the account's country (for example apartment, house). Read-only. GET /property_types.

tools.name: easybroker_list_features
tools.description: List the property features (amenities) available in the account's country. Read-only. GET /features.

tools.name: easybroker_get_location
tools.description: Look up a location by name or postal code, with its children (neighborhoods, cities, states). Use the result when a property needs a location. Read-only. GET /locations.

tools.name: easybroker_list_users
tools.description: List the active users (agents and staff) of the account. Read-only. GET /users.

tools.name: easybroker_list_collaborations
tools.description: List the collaborations (shared listings between agencies) of the account. Read-only. GET /collaborations.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: easybroker_list_contacts · Private data: easybroker_list_contacts, easybroker_get_contact, easybroker_update_contact, easybroker_list_contact_requests, easybroker_create_contact_request · Public sink: easybroker_list_contacts, easybroker_update_contact, easybroker_create_contact_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: easybroker_list_contacts · Private data: easybroker_list_contacts, easybroker_get_contact, easybroker_update_contact, easybroker_list_contact_requests, easybroker_create_contact_request · Public sink: easybroker_list_contacts, easybroker_update_contact, easybroker_create_contact_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
